name: Bat Trang porcelain tea cup
where: Authentic Bat Trang shops in the Old Quarter
about: Bat Trang is a pottery village just outside Hanoi. It has made ceramics for centuries, and its cups and bowls are a classic Hanoi souvenir.
tip: Check that the glaze is food-safe and certified for tableware before you buy.

name: Lotus tea
where: Tay Ho lotus tea specialty shops or Hien Minh Tea
about: Lotus tea is green tea scented with lotus flowers. It is a traditional drink of Hanoi, where lotus ponds around West Lake are part of daily life.
tip: Some products use artificial fragrance. Choose tea scented with real dried lotus flowers.

name: Vietnamese phin coffee filter
where: Hang Be Street in the Old Quarter
about: The phin is a small metal drip filter used to brew strong Vietnamese coffee. It is a everyday item in Hanoi cafés and homes.
tip: Compare aluminum and stainless steel models, and choose the material you prefer for daily use.
